Build distributions from a table

Source: R/import.R
cm_dist_table.Rd

Converts a table with columns key, dist and p1-p4 (distributions as in the Uncertainty section of cm_read_inputs()) into a named list of cm_dist objects, e.g. to build the arguments of cm_sampler() in R. Keys are kept as given.

Usage

cm_dist_table(x)

Arguments

x

A path to a CSV file or a data frame.

Value

A named list of cm_dist objects (names = keys).

Examples

cm_dist_table(data.frame(key = c("impact:d1", "assoc:d1:d2"),
                         dist = c("normal", "lognormal_ci"),
                         p1 = c(2.5, 2), p2 = c(0.5, 1.4), p3 = c(NA, 2.9)))
#> $`impact:d1`
#> <cm_dist> normal(mean = 2.5, sd = 0.5, lower = -Inf, upper = Inf), mean 2.5
#> 
#> $`assoc:d1:d2`
#> <cm_dist> lognormal(meanlog = 0.6931, sdlog = 0.1858), mean 2.035
#>
